label: Source
definition: Characterizes seismic sources (occurrence, size, mechanism, rupture, physics).

label: Structure
definition: Infers medium properties (velocity, attenuation, anisotropy, interfaces, temporal change).

label: Joint estimation
definition: One inversion estimates source and structure parameters together.

label: Structure → source
definition: Structure results used to obtain or interpret source results.

label: Source → structure
definition: Source results used to obtain or interpret structure results.

label: Source changes medium
definition: Events change the medium and the study measures it.

label: Parallel
definition: Both analyzed and interpreted side by side.

label: Induced EQ
definition: Injection/extraction, hydraulic fracturing, geothermal, reservoir, CO2 storage.

label: Volcanic
definition: VT, LP, VLP, volcanic tremor, eruption signals.

label: Tremor/LFE/slow slip
definition: Tectonic tremor, LFEs, VLFEs, slow slip, triggered aseismic slip.

label: Explosion
definition: Nuclear, chemical, quarry blasts studied as sources.

label: Active source
definition: Controlled sources used to probe the medium.

label: Ambient noise
definition: Diffuse noise wavefield used as a probe.

label: Landslide
definition: Landslides, rockfalls, debris flows, turbidity currents.

label: Environmental
definition: Microseism generation, rivers, storms, atmosphere, animals, traffic.

label: Other non-EQ
definition: Impacts, bolides, sonic booms, collapses, other.

label: Detection & cataloging
definition: Event detection, template matching, repeaters, catalog building.

label: Magnitude & size
definition: Magnitude, moment, yield, size, EEW magnitude.

label: Mechanism & MT
definition: Focal mechanisms, moment tensors, source type.

label: Source spectra & energy
definition: Corner frequency, stress drop, radiated energy, scaling.

label: Rupture kinematics
definition: Finite-fault slip, back-projection, STF, directivity, rupture speed.

label: Geodetic/tsunami deformation
definition: Coseismic/postseismic/slow-slip deformation and slip from geodetic or tsunami data.

label: Seismicity statistics & forecasting
definition: b-value, completeness, rates, ETAS, declustering, forecasting.

label: Rupture/cycle simulation
definition: Dynamic rupture or earthquake-cycle simulation constrained by observations.

label: Non-EQ source modeling
definition: Physical modeling of landslide, glacial, eruption, environmental sources.

label: Body-wave tomography
definition: Travel-time or finite-frequency body-wave tomography, Vp/Vs.

label: Surface-wave tomography
definition: Surface-wave dispersion and tomography from earthquakes or ambient noise.

label: Waveform inversion & modeling
definition: FWI, adjoint tomography, waveform forward modeling of structure.

label: Interface imaging (RF etc.)
definition: Receiver functions, CCP, H-kappa, SS/PP precursors, autocorrelation.

label: Deep-Earth phases & modes
definition: Core and lowermost-mantle phases, inner core, normal modes.

label: Anisotropy
definition: Shear-wave splitting, anisotropic tomography or receiver functions.

label: Temporal medium change
definition: dv/v and other temporal changes of medium properties.

label: Near-surface characterization
definition: H/V, SPAC/MASW, shallow Vs, sediment thickness.

label: Fault-zone structure
definition: Fault geometry from seismicity or imaging, fault-zone waves, damage zones.

label: Structure interpretation
definition: Interpretation of seismic models; geodynamic/rock-physics modeling constrained by seismic data.

label: Joint geophysical inversion
definition: Joint inversion of seismic with non-seismic data for structure.

label: Continuous/other (no M)
definition: Continuous signals or non-seismic data; magnitude not applicable.

label: Magnitude not stated
definition: Discrete events but no magnitude information.

label: Near-source
definition: Within a few km or the source dimension.

label: Low-cost / MEMS
definition: MEMS, Raspberry Shake, smartphones, citizen sensors.

label: Urban
definition: Urban setting stressed in the text.

label: Rapid response
definition: Deployed after an event or unrest.

label: Industry monitoring
definition: Operator monitoring of injection, geothermal, mining, storage.

label: Opportunistic
definition: Infrastructure not built for seismology (telecom fiber, phones).

label: Ultra-dense (≤1 km)
definition: Large-N nodes, DAS channels, small-aperture arrays.

label: Seismic waveforms
definition: Seismograms, spectra, noise correlations, DAS, strong motion.

label: Application
definition: Applies existing methods to real data.

label: Method development
definition: Proposes or benchmarks an analysis method.

label: Catalog / dataset / model
definition: Main product is a catalog, dataset, or reference model.

label: Observation & discovery
definition: Characterizes what is observed: structures, events, regions, new phenomena.

label: Explanation & testing
definition: Main result is a cause, mechanism, or tested hypothesis.

label: Synthesis
definition: Generalizes across many events, regions, or studies.

label: Method
definition: Proposes, improves, benchmarks, or calibrates an analysis method.

label: Resource & operations
definition: Catalogs, datasets, models, software, monitoring and real-time operations.

label: Sequence / episode
definition: One sequence, swarm, eruption, or slow-slip episode.

label: Local area
definition: One site, fault zone, volcano, or area up to ~100 km.

label: Continental / global
definition: Continental to global scale or many regions.

label: Snapshot
definition: One time window treated as static.

label: New data acquisition
definition: Instruments deployed or data collected for the study.

label: Reanalysis of published results
definition: Published catalogs, models, or results reanalyzed.

label: Oceanic transform
definition: Oceanic transform faults and fracture zones.

label: Stable continental interior
definition: Cratons, platforms, intraplate basins incl. failed rifts.

label: Passive margin
definition: Passive continental margins and their basins.

label: Oceanic plate interior
definition: Oceanic plate interiors away from boundaries.

label: Global / multi-setting
definition: Global studies or compilations across settings.
